tasks.task: Write an SEO article that beats the page ranking today

items.when: Before drafting, to fix the reader, the search, the angle and what the piece must prove
When you know the keyword and the pages that rank and need a brief, a post and fixes
When AI helps with the draft and you need the steps that keep it accurate and yours
When the title is flat, to compare several angles that earn the click without bait
When the draft is correct but dull and should sound like one person helping another
When the draft is finished, to match each claim to proof and make the words plain

tasks.task: Write a content brief or outline a writer can draft from

items.when: When you have the keyword and the ranking pages, to find the intent and the gaps
When a writer who has never met the client needs one page to draft from
When the client wants only the outline: intent, headings and what each must answer
When the draft comes back, to check it against the brief for facts, voice and structure

tasks.task: Build a one-page content strategy tied to one goal

items.when: Before choosing topics, to find the three to five subjects the client can truly own
When a small business needs one page: goal, reader, topics, channels and measures
When you must decide where each kind of piece goes and which channels to drop
When readers get the answer without clicking, to plan content that works without the visit
When the plan chases search volume and ignores where the audience really spends time

tasks.task: Plan a topic cluster for a main product or service

items.when: Before the cluster, to sort keywords by what the searcher wants and group them
When you need the full run: keywords, cluster plan, post briefs and links
When the pages exist, to decide which links to which and with what link text

tasks.task: Find topics from what customers already ask

items.when: Before any keyword tool, to turn sales and support questions into a topic list
When you have reviews, tickets and comments, to find how people would search for each
When a ticket shows a gap, to turn it into a help article that answers it once

tasks.task: Build an editorial calendar for the next quarter

items.when: Each month, to run planning, drafting, review and publishing in a fixed order
When you have a strategy and topics and need a calendar the team can keep
When each calendar slot needs its distribution: where it is shared and when

tasks.task: Write a newsletter issue

items.when: When you need this issue drafted from notes and recent content, built for clicks and replies
When the newsletter runs every week and should be checked against past issues
Before sending, to compare subject lines from several honest angles
When the issue is drafted, to get cuts, a pacing map and a ship or fix verdict

tasks.task: Turn one long piece into a repurposing pack

items.when: When a strong piece is published and should be used beyond the site, step by step
When one piece should become email, social, video and sales versions that differ
When the source is a webinar, podcast or long post and you need a series from it
Each month, to pick last month's best pieces from the results and turn them into more
When the pack is drafted, to find where versions drift from the client's voice

tasks.task: Write LinkedIn and X posts from a piece

items.when: When one idea needs an X post and a LinkedIn post that read as written apart
When the LinkedIn post needs a stronger first line, to try opening patterns
When a long idea should become a thread where each post stands alone
Before posting, to check each post against the voice and style guide

tasks.task: Write a customer case study

items.when: Before the interview, to get a timeline script that draws out what really happened
When you have the transcript, to outline the case and list the evidence gaps
When you need the case study's sections in an order that holds a reader
When the story could open several ways, to find the surprise to lead with
When the case reads like a press release and needs what happened and what it meant
Before the customer signs off, to check every result and number against its source

tasks.task: Write a fair comparison, alternative or best-of page

items.when: Before writing, to plan which best-of, alternative and versus pages to make
When one rival is named, to find the gap worth owning and write a fair page
When buyers search for the best in a category and you need a fair list with real numbers
When the page needs a table that helps people choose
When the page title must be fair and still win the click
Before publishing, to sort every claim about a rival as fine, needs proof or cut

tasks.task: Write a white paper or research report with sources

items.when: When the report starts from a question and every claim needs a source
When the material exists and needs a clear outline for a white paper
When the report rests on a survey, to test how far each result can be trusted
When the report needs a title, to compare several angles
When the findings are sound but dry and need one real case to carry the idea
When the draft is finished, to have it edited and checked until it passes

tasks.task: Plan and draft an ebook or lead magnet

items.when: Before writing, to compare lead magnet ideas and pick the one that fits the buyer
When you need the lead magnet, its signup page and the path to a sale
When scattered expertise needs a chapter order
When the ebook draft is done, to edit and re-check it before design

tasks.task: Turn a long report into a brief, deck outline or source notes

items.when: When a finished report needs a summary, a slide brief and a fact-check list
When staff, clients or a board need the report as slides they can edit
When the findings go on a poster or into a talk and every claim needs a source note
When the short version is drafted, to check no number changed on the way

tasks.task: Audit existing content against the buyer journey

items.when: Every three months, or after a search update hits the site, to run the review in order
When you have the content list, to mark each page keep, update, merge or remove
When a search tool is connected, to find missing topics, thin pages and fading posts

tasks.task: Review what the content earns

items.when: When you have search, analytics and email numbers and need to know what earned what
When the review should end in decisions: push, refresh, merge or stop
Each month, to find pages to push and thin pages from the search export
When the client wants non-branded clicks compared with the last period
When a dashboard looks good, to ask what the numbers prove about sales

tasks.task: Decide whether to refresh, merge or retire old pieces

items.when: When one old piece is losing traffic and you need a quick, reasoned call
When many posts are fading and each needs a decision and tracking
Each month, to catch pages losing ground before the quarter's review

tasks.task: Write titles, meta descriptions and headlines

items.when: When a page needs three titles and descriptions that fit the length limits
When you want several headline angles before you pick one
When you have a list, to score each headline read alone and keep the best three

tasks.task: Check and edit a draft before it is published

items.when: When AI helped write it, to run the checks that stop slop reaching the site
When lines sound machine made, to fix each one and see a score
When the piece is cluttered, to find the point and cut every word that does no work
When there is a brief, to check facts, voice, structure and search basics against it

tasks.task: Make a piece easy for AI answers to quote

items.when: When a page is live, to score how easily AI tools can quote each passage
When the score is low, to get edits that help AI answers and search find and cite it

tasks.task: Write a stop-by-stop tour or audio guide script

items.when: Before scripting, to draw the guide's own stories and judgment out in an interview
When the script will be recorded and needs a checked spoken version and a text copy
When a stop has many facts, to pick the one story to tell there
When the script is drafted, to fix every line that trips when spoken
When the site has no voice artist and needs the audio guide tracks recorded

tasks.task: Write tour listing copy and a short preview video script

items.when: When the booking page needs a headline, what guests get and one clear next step
When a preview video is planned, to pick a format and get a script outline
Before it goes on a booking site, to fix lines that sound like every other listing

tasks.task: Plan distribution for a new piece

items.when: When a new piece is published and needs its sharing plan run in order
When you must choose where to share it, when, and which channels to skip
When a guide is worth sharing, to plan who to contact with a personal note

always.when: Before any work for a client with a live site, to capture their voice, facts and prices
When a piece states facts or numbers, to check each against a trusted source
Before anything ships, to fix lines that read as machine written
Last step before sign-off, to catch slips with a log of every change

helpers.when: When the job needs technical SEO, a site audit or keyword data beyond one article
When the repurposed posts need scheduling, community replies and a channel plan
When the newsletter needs list set-up, automation or deliverability work
When a report, ebook or deck needs a designed layout
When the performance review needs tracking set up or attribution worked out
When the client wants a full plan to be named in AI answers

No library item builds a quote and idea bank from a webinar or podcast transcript
No library item writes a why-switch page
No library item drafts an ebook chapter by chapter; the structurer gives only the outline
No library item reads self-reported answers to how did you hear about us beside search and email results
No library item makes clearly different versions of a repurposing pack or of a report summary for staff, clients and boards
